mainEntity.name: Can I make changes to my luxury home design once construction has started, and how does that impact the schedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: While design changes are best implemented before construction begins, we understand that adjustments may sometimes be necessary for a custom luxury home. Our process allows for change orders, which involve formally documenting the requested modifications, assessing their impact on the schedule, budget, and material procurement, and then presenting a revised plan for your approval. Any changes will necessitate adjustments to the existing schedule, but our flexible approach aims to minimize disruption while accommodating your evolving vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, design changes are possible after construction starts, but they require a formal change order process to assess and adjust the schedule, budget, and material procurement.
